key GTM metrics, ensuring teams have a shared understanding of how performance is measured. **Business Decision Support \& Data Enablement** * Partner closely with BD, CSM, and leadership teams to translate business questions into structured analyses and decision frameworks. * Provide analytical support for strategic and ad\-hoc business questions, while identifying opportunities to convert recurring requests into standardized reporting or self\-service solutions. * Help stakeholders interpret performance data and develop stronger data\-driven decision\-making capabilities across the GTM
